$comment: The primary browse axis for the exercise library -- what KIND of training a movement belongs to. This is deliberately separate from `category` (what it trains), `movementPattern` (how the body moves) and `equipment` (what it needs), because a coach filters on all four independently: 'calisthenics pull exercises for someone who only has a bar' is discipline + pattern + equipment. Single-valued on each exercise.

items.label: Calisthenics
items.description: Bodyweight as the resistance. Progression comes from leverage, range and unilateral loading rather than added plates.
items.equipmentHint: Nothing, or a bar, rings, parallettes, a bench or a band.

items.label: Gym
items.description: Externally loaded resistance work: barbells, dumbbells, kettlebells, machines and cables.

items.label: Cardio
items.description: Continuous or interval conditioning, on a machine or on foot.

items.label: Mobility
items.description: Range-of-motion, stretching and preparation work. Prescribed for quality, not intensity.
items.equipmentHint: Floor space, sometimes a band or roller.

note: Sports are NOT a discipline here. A sport is an activity (catalog/activities.json) logged by duration and intensity, not a prescribable exercise. See the README.
